newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai PM wins vote but to resign in seven days.
newsitem.headline: Thai PM wins vote but to resign in seven days.

text.p: Thai Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa won a no-confidence vote in parliament on Saturday after he said he would resign as premier within seven days.

He earlier told a news conference that he had agreed to resign after finding a suitable replacement from within his six-party coalition, in exchange for support from his coalition partners at the vote.
